venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — shotgun, huddle pace, Baugh and the quick game
dek: Sat the 20:11 SEC condensed game. Broadcast angle. Not All-22. Condensed cuts skip huddles — do not read that as hurry-up. Official drive times say Florida played at huddle pace.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — 20:11 SEC condensed game sat (Charles Drive upload). Broadcast condensed, not All-22, not every snap. Charles corrected the no-huddle identity: Florida did not live in hurry-up. Fan rail stays empty until he approves publish.

sources.label: Official box / PBP (tempo + stats support — not the film)

headline: Shotgun is the base. They huddle. Baugh and the quick game do the damage. White’s Saturday look is 4-down with stand-up edges. The leaks are contain and the fade.

offense.kicker: Buster Faulkner — what he is designing
offense.body:
Faulkner’s Saturday look is shotgun, 11 personnel: one back, one tight end, three out. That is the formation. It is not a no-huddle identity.

The condensed cut skips the huddle. The official chart stamps almost every shotgun snap “No Huddle-Shotgun.” Both will lie to you. The game clock does not. Opening drive: 7 plays, 94 yards, 3:20 — about 29 seconds between snaps. The Clark touchdown drive: 8 plays, 79 yards, 4:47. Jones Jr. late: 11 plays, 6:14. That is huddle pace. The one fast trip is the short field after the punt — Stockton in 3 plays, 0:50. Do not build an offense around that. FAU is the hurry-up team (13 plays, 75 yards, 3:12).

The run is built around Jadan Baugh (No. 13). Inside zone is the early-down answer — Baugh hits it, or he bounces when the front clogs. On the short-field drive he wins the edge for 18. Later the red zone is downhill — pad down, puller, finish. Three rushing touchdowns, three answers: backside cut, bounce-and-pad, power through the pile. Official chart keeps those in shotgun. We are not inventing an under-center toss from a wide camera.

The pass game is rhythm, then a shot. Opening score: Aaron Philo (No. 12) gets it out now to Vernell Brown III (No. 1). First man misses. Brown races it 49. Next trip: Philo to Bailey Stockton (No. 3) at the pylon. After FAU punches in, max protect, Philo to TJ Abrams (No. 4) down the right side — the 63 that puts them at the door. Then empty at the 3: the edges climb, Philo keeps, he walks it in. The one sneak we can call under center is the 4th-and-1 at midfield — official chart drops the shotgun tag.

Motion and play-action show up after Baugh has already won. Duke Clark (No. 20) is the second-back finisher. Tramell Jones Jr. (No. 9) takes the last drive. The cut does not give a full Jones grade.

What this still is not: an elite call sheet. Condensed hides personnel shifts, the protection slide, and most first-and-second down answers. We are not inventing RPO or Wildcat.
bullets: Base look: shotgun, 11 personnel. Pace: huddle. Not a hurry-up identity.
Official “No Huddle-Shotgun” tag is a chart stamp. Drive times say otherwise.
Baugh: inside zone, bounce, power. Three TDs, three looks. All shotgun on the chart.
Quick game: Brown III 49 after the first man misses. Stockton to the pylon.
The shot: max protect, Philo to Abrams down the right sideline.
Red zone: empty keep by Philo; Clark as the closer.

defense.kicker: Brad White — what he is lining up
defense.body:
White’s look on this condensed cut is a 4-down surface with stand-up edges — two hands in the dirt, two ends who can rush or drop. That is the Saturday tell. He is not stuck there. On 3rd-and-10 empty to open the night he shows 3-down, linebackers walking, then a 4-man rush into a zone drop. FAU’s first drive lives on hitch, flat, and out — and they are the ones in true no-huddle. Then the ball comes out late and DJ Coleman (No. 33) ends it at the Florida 6.

He mixes one-high and two-high. Off coverage on the outside is how Veltkamp (No. 10) moves the chains early — complete, rally, tackle. Myles Graham (No. 5) and the back seven show up in the pile. That is not a hold. That is a first-quarter drive that keeps converting until the takeaway.

The leaks on this tape are the ones fans already felt. Goal line: White packs the box and still loses the phone booth to Ethan Ervin. Third-and-goal: 3-down, stand-up edges, Veltkamp flushes and dives the pylon — Kamran James (No. 24) is in the picture; contain lost. Late: Kelby Valsin (No. 2) beats J’Vari Flowers (No. 6) and FAU punches the 20-yard score. Same family as Stockton the other way — fade / boundary, lost leverage.

The other takeaway still stands: A-gap heat, Veltkamp off the back foot, Dijon Johnson (No. 27) high-points it, Coleman on the breakup. Condensed also shows White getting off the field on fourth down in the second half. Do not turn 21 points into a season identity, and do not write a lockdown essay from a cut that skips the long FAU drives.

Bett’s strip is on the official chart in the fourth. This camera does not give a clean All-22 of the rush plan. We are not inventing the stunt.
bullets: Base look: 4-down, stand-up edges. Mixes 3-down on obvious pass.
Shell: one-high and two-high. Do not name Cover 3 from this camera.
Coleman: 3rd-and-10, empty, drive dies at the Florida 6.
Johnson: back-foot duck after interior heat. High-point.
Leaks: Ervin phone-booth dive; Veltkamp pylon scramble; Valsin vs Flowers.
Graham, James, Bett show up. This is not a full-snap grade.

specials.kicker: Specials — the kick on the cut
specials.body: Patrick Durkin from 53, 4th-and-4, 2:06 of the first. Left hash, clean operation, down the middle. Makes it 17–0. Kickoffs on this cut are touchbacks. Florida never punts on the package. Unused punter stays a box fact.
bullets: No Florida punt on this tape.

keys: Faulkner: shotgun 11 at huddle pace. Zone and bounce for Baugh, then quick game and one deep shot.
Do not call this no-huddle. Condensed skips huddles. Official TOP is 25–35 seconds a snap on the long drives.
Philo: ball out on time; empty keep when the edges climb; the Abrams ball is the shot.
White: 4-down, stand-up edges, mix the high safety. Default rush is four.
Who stood out on this cut: Baugh, Philo, Brown III, Stockton, Abrams, Clark, Coleman, Durkin.
The leaks: contain (Veltkamp) and the fade (Valsin / Flowers). Campbell will test both.

nextWeek.look: Home Saturday 5:30. Campbell is the no-huddle team. Florida’s tape vs FAU is shotgun at huddle pace. White has to set the edge and win the fade.
